x5gtqjxd.sourceDescription: This hugely popular snow-covered Christmas tree range is a real head turner! Our customers love how closely the Pre-lit Snowy Alpine replicates the freshly cut, snowy trees from Christmas films. Combining a flocked and frosted mix of traditional PVC and expertly moulded PE branch tips, you get a realistic Christmas tree that doesn't scrimp on essential snowy features. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. wjdnfeb7.baseName: Pegdev Artificial Christmas Tree Stand with 5 Legs and 3 Adjustable Clamps
wjdnfeb7.variantName: Pegdev Artificial Christmas Tree Stand with 5 Legs and 3 Adjustable Clamps
wjdnfeb7.sourceDescription: Ensure your Christmas tree remains upright and secure throughout the festive season with this sturdy artificial Christmas tree stand. Designed for practicality and stability, the stand features five robust plastic legs that provide a firm base, preventing your tree from tipping over. Three adjustable clamps hold the tree securely in place and can be positioned to accommodate trunks with diameters of 3/4, 7/8 or 1 1/4 inches, depending on your tree. Assembly is extremely quick and simple, requiring no tools, making it ideal for hassle-free setup each year. Durable and reliable, this stand is built for repeated use, allowing you to enjoy a perfectly upright tree year after year. Whether you have a small tree for a cosy corner or a larger one for a central display, this stand offers versatile support and peace of mind, ensuring your festive decorations stay just where you want them throughout the Christmas period. No specific safety warnings required when used as intended. Please use the product in accordance with its intended purpose. Pegdev Limited, Haywood Park Cotts (Main A513), Shugborough, Stafford, ST17 0XA
